tidbit: Did you know… about 14,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
States are suing OpenAI, saying the chatbot is hurting children and deceiving adults. Reported by The Miami Times.
China is proposing export controls on 23 artificial intelligence technologies, including models and clusters. Confirmed by RTTNews.
ASUS launched ProArt P16 and P14 laptops powered by NVIDIA RTX Spark for local artificial intelligence in Canada. Reported by MarketScreener.
Anthropic staff expect artificial intelligence to handle 80 percent of their jobs by 2030, far beyond what most U.S. workers think. Reported by Business Insider.
EverWind's data centre at Point Tupper will support artificial intelligence growth with 420MW capacity and 2,000 construction jobs. Reported by Global News.
Free every hour.
